groups.id: detail.parquet|changed rec_len|value differs on matched key
groups.cause: Walling and five Natural Resources document pages each lose one recovery link to a reviewed bad file. Their document links still resolve.

groups.id: detail.parquet|changed saved_body|value differs on matched key
groups.cause: The 31 reviewed document pages withdraw 30 distinct unusable primary files. All 32 document links still open their original records.

groups.id: detail.parquet|changed saved_bytes|value differs on matched key
groups.cause: Clear the byte count on the same 31 detail pages whose primary file was withdrawn.

groups.id: detail.parquet|changed saved_media_type|value differs on matched key
groups.cause: Clear the media type on the same 31 detail pages whose primary file was withdrawn.

groups.id: detail.parquet|changed saved_suffix|value differs on matched key
groups.cause: Clear the storage suffix on the same 31 detail pages whose primary file was withdrawn.
Remove the six recovery entries whose exact bytes were also unusable. The separately verified Vargas testimony remains available.
The schema allows four primary-download fields to be empty and explains why. Applying only these four field changes to the previous schema reproduces the candidate file hash.

groups.id: sources.parquet|changed is_saved|value differs on matched key
groups.cause: The 25 source rows previously labeled as the saved copy now describe an address without implying that it supplies a usable download.
